_about: How data/exercise-rankings.source.md maps to Hevy. Keys are '<list> / <exercise as written>', the list named as in the doc's heading ("Glute Exercises" is Glute). hevyIds [] means Hevy has no such exercise; variation means the tier only holds done as named; muscles overrides the list's muscles (lists without them need it on every entry); tier, name and note override the doc's; skip leaves an entry out. cues names the entries each numbered cue in the doc belongs to; estimates rank exercises no list covers. Run npm run build:rankings after editing either file.
